# Edward Suarez

Edward Suarez is a DevOps and SRE engineer based in Medellín, Colombia.
His technology career began in November 2020.

## Professional experience
- UST / Banco Santander: Developer III – DevOps Engineering, focused on production releases, pipeline operations, application monitoring and incident support.
- Pragma / Bancolombia: automation and implementation of reliability practices, including Golden Signals, SLA/SLI/SLO, critical paths, Dynatrace configuration and chaos engineering activities.
- Mercado Libre: previous professional backend development experience with Go.
- SETI: participation in on-premises-to-AWS migrations using existing templates and frameworks.
- Almícava (Integ.ro): environment setup, Bash automation, deployments, incident support and backup restoration.

## Independent project
Coravit is a current independent business and engineering project developed with substantial AI assistance. Its monitoring implementation with Prometheus and Grafana was largely AI-generated.

## Certification
AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner.

## Current development
Cloud and platform engineering foundations, Terraform, Kubernetes and programming.
